R-hierarchy.reason: Album art, the Fraunces title, and the large filled play/pause button lead clearly; secondary toggles and the sheet actions are quieter.

R-fill.reason: The play/pause button is the only strong saturated fill; previous/next and the toolbar use light tonal containers.

R-surfaces.reason: A calm blush/near-black surface backs the content, and tonal containers group the transport and sheet actions without competing.

R-controls.reason: Lyrics, Queue, and Credits are borderless text buttons inside one tonal pill, so the toolbar reads as a single wide pill rather than three separate controls.

R-font.reason: 'Golden Hour' uses Fraunces at its default regular weight with no visible axis treatment, which reads as a brand face swapped in without intent.

R-platform.reason: No disclosure chevrons or Cancel/Done text; the sheets use a drag handle and close icon, and content runs edge to edge.

R-text.reason: No text is clipped or overlapping in the plain renders or in the sheet contents across sizes.

R-dark.reason: In dark, the pink accents, white text, and tonal buttons are all legible against the near-black surface.

R-adaptive.reason: The tablet and desktop renders use a two-column layout that adds an 'Up next' section, and the sheets become a side sheet; nothing overflows or overlaps.

R-idea.reason: Apart from the wavy progress bar and the highlighted lyric line, this is a standard catalog now-playing layout with no specific design idea.

R-semantics.reason: 'Up next' and the sheet titles carry heading(), and the toggles are single IconToggleButtons with no rows that toggle.

R-fields.reason: The proposal contains no text fields.

R-visibility.reason: The sheet is shown through AnimatedVisibility plus a null check, so it leaves the composition when hidden.

R-blur.reason: No blur is used; the sheets sit on solid surfaces over a scrim.

R-music-actions.reason: The three actions are icon+label TextButtons with no individual containers inside one tonal pill, so they read as one wide pill rather than distinct icon buttons.
